title: How many comparisons does bubble sort make?
summary: Watch bubble sort reorder a list, counting each pair it compares, and work out how many comparisons the whole sort takes on that list.

accessibility.screenReaderSummary: A row of numbered blocks that swap places as bubble sort runs, a running comparison counter, a pass slider, and a box for the total.
accessibility.textAlternative: A list of different numbers is sorted into order by repeatedly comparing each pair of neighbours and swapping them when the left is bigger, stopping once a whole pass swaps nothing. The numbers being sorted are given. The task is to work out how many comparisons the whole sort makes.

grading.rationaleTemplate: You said {answer}. The count depends on this list, not only on how many numbers are in it, and n(n-1)/2 is only the ceiling.
